topic.description: Brief topic or hook for the short.

bridge_proxy_target.comment: When STARGATE Bridge hosts the Realtime client, replace OpenAI stub at POST /api/realtime with xAI client_secrets + model grok-voice-latest, voice ara.

notes: Ara = xAI built-in voice (consensus: Aria maps to Ara in xAI roster).
grok-voice-latest tracks current recommended model (e.g. grok-voice-think-fast-1.0).
OpenAI Realtime-compatible — same event types (session.update, input_audio_buffer.append, response.output_audio.delta).
See docs/VOICE-INTEGRATION.md for Bridge swap spec.
